snippet.title: Korpus: Buried over the Black Soil - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Korpus: Buried over the Black Soil is a first-person horror game in which you have been sent to evaluate an abandoned house, set somewhere in Eastern Europe. Uncover the houses past and the secrets buried within.

The game will be released 14.2.2020 on Steam and itch.io.

You can find Korpus on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236190/Korpus_Buried_over_the_Black_Soil

You can find Korpus on itch.io here:
https://korpus.itch.io/korpus
